title: Where the members are
description:
Print the offset and size of every member of a struct, and the padding between them.

```
struct Mixed (24 bytes, align 8)
  offset 0  size 1  char tag
  (7 bytes of padding)
  offset 8  size 8  double value
  offset 16 size 4  int count
  (4 bytes of padding at the end)
```
hints: The padding after a member is the next member's offset minus (this offset + this size) (lesson 3.01).
Largest alignment first (`double`, then `int`, then `char`) packs this struct into 16 bytes.
requirements: Reorder the members to remove the padding and print the new size.
stretch: Do the same for a struct that holds another struct and an array.
